entities.summary: James Elisha Folsom Jr. is an American politician who was the 50th governor of Alabama from April 22, 1993, to January 16, 1995. He has also served as the 25th and 29th lieutenant governor of Alabama. He is a member of the Democratic Party. was a performers & entertainers from Montgomery (b. 1949-05-14, Montgomery). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
